_notes: All other MN placer keys (672) resolved to a class year in the build; graduated classes (2024-2026) mint no profiles by design and are not listed individually.

MSHSL permits 7th/8th-grade varsity participation: 69 pre-freshman placer rows are legitimate data, proven by the package's own grade prints (e.g., Cayden Neisen grade 7 in 2024; Grayson Eggum grade 8 in 2024). A pre-freshman gate that fails MN on those rows is miscalibrated for this association.
